23b Covenant of circumcision
Yes: the covenant of circumcision was an administration of the covenant of grace, and the infant seed are in the covenant.
No: the covenant of circumcision was not an administration of the covenant of grace.
Baptism is administered once. The sprinkling of an infant is not baptism, so the baptism of a professing believer who was sprinkled in infancy is his first baptism, not a repetition.
33d Validity of baptism
Subject, mode and formula: a professing believer, immersed, in the triune name.
Subject, mode and formula, and the administrator a church of gospel order, defined by doctrine, not by identity or succession.
Subject, mode and formula, and the administrator a church of our own order, by identity or succession.

value.proposed: A baptism is valid when three things hold: the subject is a professing believer; the administration is according to the Word (immersion, in the triune name); and the administrator is a church of gospel order, not identity or succession. A baptism lacking any of the three is no baptism.
